title: Ice Cold
description: This Mod adds our favourite Summer snack to the Game: Ice Cream.
body:
This is a Mod for Minecraft, which adds our all Favourite Summer snack to the Game: Ice Cream.
Have you ever walked around your minecraft World, looking for some Refreshing snack? Well look no further than this delicious Ice cream. Eat them with the Cone, and you can get some Special Effects.
